title: Classic Game Postmortem: Fallout
summary: Timothy Cain's 2012 GDC postmortem of the original Fallout, covering how he helped build the game and set the template for open-world RPGs. He talks through production, design and programming decisions.
why: Held up as an exemplary GDC postmortem and a first-hand account for fans of the original Fallout.

quote.text: GDC post mortems are amazing, especially the ones on Diablo[0] and Fallout[1].
